summary: Recursive harness improvement plus closed learning loop plus benchmark-archive-improve cycle: Harness2 pattern (Propose-Probe-Compose - propose edits, probe effects on the same task, compose from behavioral contrasts with no ground truth needed; harnessing-level recursion - persistent improvement harness updated only with adopted harnesses and evidence-supported lessons; eight-component harness checklist as a review shape); Hermes Agent pattern (agent-curated memory with periodic nudges mapped to the intake cadence, autonomous skill creation with every improvement passing the existing gate, skills self-improving during use, agentskills.io-compatible skill record shape); SICA pattern (evaluate on benchmark tasks, archive results, improve, re-benchmark on the SAME set; results archive as evidence base, run variance recorded not smoothed). Patterns restated in our own words; no code copied.
